sources.name: TreeRegisterPoints
sources.license: Auckland Council Open Data licence / CC BY 4.0 with council caveats
sources.notes: Tree register points surfaced through the Waitemata Urban Forest public ArcGIS content. Strong first candidate for tree-by-tree species inventory, but spatial coverage appears local rather than all Auckland.

sources.name: Notable Trees Overlay
sources.license: Auckland Council Open Data licence / CC BY 4.0 with council caveats
sources.notes: Auckland Unitary Plan D13 / Schedule 10 notable tree point overlay. Useful for protected status and validation, not a complete tree inventory.

sources.name: Notable Group of Trees Overlay
sources.license: Auckland Council Open Data licence / CC BY 4.0 with council caveats
sources.notes: Polygon overlay for protected/notable groups of trees. Useful for protected status and validation; tree counts inside polygons must be inferred or sourced separately.

sources.name: Ruru ObsKauri Tiaki (Valid and Public)
sources.license: Auckland Council data licence with biosecurity caveats
sources.notes: Public valid kauri survey and Phytophthora observations. The source description says it does not provide a complete picture of kauri or kauri dieback distribution.

sources.name: Auckland Part 1 LiDAR 1m DEM (2024)
sources.notes: Bare-earth elevation, needed with DSM for canopy height.

sources.name: Auckland Part 2 LiDAR 1m DEM (2024)
sources.notes: Bare-earth elevation, second Auckland 2024 coverage segment.

sources.name: Auckland Part 1 LiDAR 1m DSM (2024)
sources.notes: Surface elevation including buildings and vegetation, needed with DEM for canopy height.

sources.name: Auckland Part 2 LiDAR 1m DSM (2024)
sources.notes: Surface elevation, second Auckland 2024 coverage segment.

sources.name: Auckland Part 1 LiDAR Point Cloud (2024)
sources.notes: Point cloud layer referenced by the Part 1 LiDAR index tile metadata. The v1 API metadata endpoint did not accept this opaque web-layer ID; confirm API/export route before bulk downloading.

sources.name: Auckland Part 2 LiDAR 1m Point Cloud (2024)
sources.notes: Point cloud layer referenced by the Part 2 LiDAR index tile metadata. The v1 API metadata endpoint did not accept this opaque web-layer ID; confirm API/export route before bulk downloading.

sources.name: Auckland 0.075m Urban Aerial Photos (2024-2025)
sources.notes: High-resolution urban imagery for canopy delineation and species/crown model features.

sources.name: Auckland 0.075m Urban Aerial Photos Index Tiles (2024-2025)
sources.notes: Aerial imagery tile index for targeted downloading.

sources.name: Auckland 0.25m Rural Aerial Photos (2024)
sources.notes: Rural imagery for regional coverage outside the 7.5 cm urban layer.

sources.name: NZ Building Outlines
sources.notes: Authoritative building footprint source needed to mask buildings from DSM-DEM canopy candidates. Metadata is public; spatial query/WFS service advertises API-key authentication.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap Buildings via Overpass (Waitemata Pilot)
sources.notes: Interim public building mask used only for the Waitemata crown segmentation pilot until authoritative LINZ building outlines are wired into the processing pipeline.

sources.name: Auckland Region Digital Surface Model (DSM) 2024
sources.notes: Auckland Council image service for regional 1m DSM, useful for viewing and targeted export. Full download may require contacting gis@aklc.govt.nz.

sources.name: Auckland Region Digital Elevation Model (DEM) 2024
sources.notes: Auckland Council 1m DEM tiled ImageServer used in the Waitemata LiDAR pilot. DEM is paired with the 2024 DSM to compute canopy height.
